subject.title: fix(onboard): never silently remap an existing fleet's workspaces

question: When non-interactive onboarding receives an explicit workspace different from an existing fleet workspace, should it fail with an actionable message or support an explicit unattended confirmation mechanism?
rationale: The PR deliberately changes a documented CLI outcome for existing automation; choosing between fail-safe rejection and an explicit override is a public onboarding contract decision.

options.title: Fail on conflict
options.body: Stop non-interactive onboarding before the workspace write and direct operators to an explicit interactive or documented recovery flow.

options.title: Add explicit unattended consent
options.body: Keep the guard by default but define a clearly named opt-in confirmation for automation that intentionally moves an existing fleet.

recommendation.title: Fail on conflict
recommendation.body: Stop non-interactive onboarding before the workspace write and direct operators to an explicit interactive or documented recovery flow.

likelyOwner.reason: This contributor is directly connected to the current onboarding-workspace proposal and can clarify the intended CLI contract.
